name: Atherve Kulkarni
des: Rafin is very bright. He loves to learn and he focuses on his passion. Rafin is self motivated and never seeks inspiration from outside to make things happen. He has a knack for problem solving and he moves mountains at his workplace single-handedly. Never says no to a challenge and never leaves unfinished business at the workplace. He is a gem of a person and any company where he joins can be considered lucky to have him there.

name: Rahman M. Mahbub
designation: Associate Professor and Head, Department of English Language and Literature ,
des: I am proud and pleased to strongly recommend Rafin Hossain for the position of MERN Stack Developer.Rafin Hossain is very polite and gentle. He is very popular among his friends and fellow-mates. He possesses an impressive personality and has the ability to work individually and with others in a group under pressure. I am confident that he is qualified for the position, and I believe he will contribute to the advancement of your institution, as well as the advancement of his career.
